title: Harnessing wetting transitions to program dual-mode antibacterial textiles
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29529-29541
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01949H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sujin Jeong, Kyeongeun Lee, Sebin Lee, Jooyoun Kim
A time-sequenced dual-defense textile was developed using Cu/Zn bimetallic imidazolate frameworks on cotton. Interfacial wetting drives a transition from bacteria-repellent superhydrophobicity to Cu-mediated ROS bactericidal activity.
